tasks.description: Premium Fleet Comparison System: A comprehensive multi-vehicle evaluation framework allowing users and administrators to compare technical specifications side-by-side with real-time selection persistence and limit validation.
acceptance_criteria: Public users can toggle vehicles for comparison using a dedicated 'Compare' button on the /browse page, triggering a success toast and a glassmorphic floating bar showing accurate selection counts.
Selection status persists when navigating between the catalog, individual vehicle details page, and back, with the button state reflecting 'In Comparison'.
Users can add/remove vehicles from comparison directly from the /car/:id overview section using a matching 'Compare' toggle with toast confirmation on addition.
Users can click a 'Clear Comparison' button within the floating comparison bar to instantly remove all currently selected vehicles from the comparison list and hide the bar.
Comparing 2 or more vehicles generates a technical side-by-side spec table on the /compare page.
Each column in the comparison matrix features the vehicle's high-resolution image and a 'View Masterpiece' button that successfully lands the user on the specific /car/:id profile.
Authenticated administrators can utilize the comparison system while managing the fleet to evaluate market positioning.
Attempting to select more than 4 vehicles triggers a warning toast: 'Maximum 4 vehicles can be compared at once' and blocks the addition.
Attempting to launch a comparison with fewer than 2 vehicles triggers an info toast: 'Select at least 2 vehicles to compare' and prevents navigation.
Direct navigation to /compare with no vehicles selected displays a 'Comparison Empty' fallback with a 'Browse Fleet' option.
